method: Re-measured directly against v53.16 HEAD source (bootstrap.js module wiring, router.js transition, PAGES init literals, cross-grep of native writer ids against js/*.js and index.html). Not copied from prior declarations.
rm01Note: RM-01 (2026-07-19) deleted every native setText/textContent write this file's contestedIds/legacyWriterEvidence originally documented as a live race (per RM-01 §2 default action: delete native, keep legacy). Those fields are kept as a historical DELETE-LEDGER record of what was found and removed, not a claim that the race is still live — for the 15 rendererOwner='legacy' routes, native no longer writes any of these ids at all. The real ARX cutover (deleting the *legacy* writer so native can take sole ownership) remains future per-route work; see route-owners.json openItems and the execution plan's ARX-05..11 packets.
rm05AgDomWriterProcedure: AG-DOM-WRITER (scripts/ci-architecture-contract-check.mjs) asserts the intersection of ids written by src/ui/pages/*.js and ids written by js/*.js+index.html is empty, except entries in domWriterIntersectionAllowlist below. Procedure for a real future route cutover (deleting the *legacy* writer so native takes sole ownership of a currently-legacy-owned id): (1) delete the legacy writer line(s) named in that route's legacyWriterEvidence array in this file; (2) re-add the native setText/textContent write for that id in the route's src/ui/pages/*.js module; (3) update that route's rendererOwner to 'native' and move its ids from contestedIds to a cleared state in this file; (4) if the id is also referenced by routeOwners.legacySymbolsMustBeAbsent for ANY renderer-native route (i.e. legacy code must never reintroduce a writer for it), add it there. Do NOT add a newly-cut-over id to domWriterIntersectionAllowlist — that list is exclusively for ids where legacy legitimately READS (not writes) a value native owns (see fg-score-big/pc-score-big below); an allowlist entry for a genuine two-way content race would defeat the gate's purpose.

columnDefinitions.lifecycleOwner: who mounts/disposes the route (native = ESM router transition owns it; PAGES[route].init is null)
columnDefinitions.rendererOwner: who owns the visible DOM content nodes for this route with no competing writer
columnDefinitions.dataOwner: who owns the fetch/normalize pipeline (native = independent of legacy.read* projection)
columnDefinitions.chartOwner: who owns chart/canvas instance lifecycle for this route
columnDefinitions.narrativeOwner: who generates the route's prose/summary text

domWriterIntersectionAllowlistNotes.fg-score-big: js/aio-data.js's dormant-until-deferred _generateSentimentAnalysis (called via setTimeout from js/aio-data.js:16811/16819/16825) only READS this via getElementById+textContent to build its analysis text; sentiment.js is the sole WRITER. Legitimate read dependency, not a write race.
domWriterIntersectionAllowlistNotes.pc-score-big: Same function/relationship as fg-score-big — read-only legacy consumer, sentiment.js is the sole writer.
